To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

nine proteins that differ in abundance in membrane preparations derived from wildtype ETEC vs. a T2SS mutant were expressed and purified, that immunization with three of the proteins (ETEC_2479, MipA, and Skp) induced a secretory IgA response, and that mice immunized with ETEC 2479, MIP, or Skp were protected in an intranasal challenge with ETEE H10407.
we identified nine ETEC proteins that generated significant immune response in mice and that we demonstrated that three of the proteins protected mice from a lethal intranasal challenge of ETEC.
we identified nine ETEC membrane proteins that generated significant immune response in mice.
